changeSet.comment: nexus-p2m1x.27 (RDR-229 P3.7): a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE row trigger on nexus.catalog_document_chunks, nexus.chunk_orphaned_at and nexus.topic_assignments sets the child row's collection name (source_collection on topic_assignments) from the chunk row it references, found by the chunk's key (the primary key under the supplied name, else the child's collection id), so a child row written under a renamed collection's new label for an existing chunk takes the chunk's stored name and the chunk name key holds; and an AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE FOR EACH STATEMENT trigger on each table logs a replaced name once per statement (RAISE LOG, the count and the first pair). SECURITY INVOKER, EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC. No data effect: function and trigger definitions only. Dropped with the name columns in P4.1.
